name: BigCommerce
description: Ecommerce: SaaS online-store platform with REST and GraphQL Admin/Storefront APIs for catalog, orders, customers and checkout.
access_notes: Store owners/authorized users can create store-level API accounts (static access token, client ID/secret) directly in any store's control panel, including free-trial stores; app developers register app-level credentials in the free Developer Portal (devtools.bigcommerce.com) and get per-store tokens via the OAuth code grant. All tokens are passed in the X-Auth-Token header.
mcp_notes: Official BigCommerce Storefront MCP server (B2C, beta; GA to all stores since April 2026) — store-specific hosted MCP URL enabled under Settings > Early access; plus an official docs MCP server at docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server. No Composio BigCommerce toolkit found (composio.dev/toolkits/bigcommerce and docs.composio.dev/toolkits/bigcommerce return 404).
uncertainty_notes: A live store (trial or paid) is needed to generate store-level credentials; the Storefront MCP server covers shopper flows (search, cart, checkout URL) and must be enabled by the store owner.

evidence.note: Three OAuth-based API account types: store-level (static access token created in control panel), app-level (Developer Portal), account-level; X-Auth-Token header.
Single-click apps use OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant against https://login.bigcommerce.com/oauth2/token.
Webhooks created via POST /stores/{hash}/v3/hooks with scopes like store/order/updated.
Official BigCommerce MCP server docs: B2C Storefront server in beta, enabled per store, store-specific MCP URL.
REST Admin APIs and GraphQL Admin API both authenticated via X-Auth-Token OAuth tokens.
